attributes.during:
Your ship is anchored at the Sea Fort. 
Create the blessings deck with 22 blessings and 8 Shipwreck henchmen.
After you advance the blessings deck, if the top card of its discard pile is a Shipwreck, summon and encounter a random ship and attempt a check to repair it. If you succeed, stash a plunder card; if you fail, summon and encounter the villain The Pirate Council.
